name: VA-08
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Don Beyer running with $2.1M raised vs. $22K for the Republican
Prediction markets price Beyer at ~96% to win
model.rationale: Beyer holds a heavily Democratic Northern Virginia seat, has a massive fundraising advantage, and markets price his reelection near certain. No polls or expert ratings contradict the fundamentals, so the forecast stays at a roughly 28-point Democratic margin.
model.watch: A polling surprise or major external shock to the national environment would be needed to move this race at all.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Don Beyer seeks another term in a Northern Virginia district that leans Democratic by 26 points. He has raised about $2.1 million and holds over $800,000 on hand, while Republican Tony Sabio has raised under $25,000. A Libertarian and an independent are also on the ballot but lack resources.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Beyer roughly a 96 percent chance of winning. With the incumbent renominated, a dominant money edge, and a strong partisan baseline, this race sits firmly in the Safe Democratic category with little realistic path for an upset.
